consequence.statement: Only the wording of errors about immutable StatefulSet fields changes. The evidence names no impact on configuration or workloads.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 improves the error messages shown when a sync tries to change an immutable StatefulSet field; this is a message change with no stated operational consequence.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence is only a changelog title. It names no setting, field or condition that decides which environments see the new error messages.
